# Synthetic router parity fixture

These files were generated by `test_export_synthetic_artifact_and_report` using
only its synthetic question corpus and sklearn classifiers, with C values 0.1
and 1. They contain no real labeling data. The parity file has 200 test examples,
including empty, unknown, repeated, mixed-case, Unicode, and multiline text.

The default `tests/test_router.py` compares the dependency-free scorer with these
saved sklearn probabilities at absolute tolerance 1e-9. The router-group exporter
tests independently regenerate and check the same synthetic experiment in a
temporary directory; no real export is run by tests.
